senses.gloss: m. (Shaf. of נְכַת; v. שתך) corrosion, rust (cmp. Lat. morsus).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 65a:14">Sabb. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>אלא משום ש׳ וכ׳</he> but (if a coin is chosen to be put on a callus on the sole of the foot) on account of the corrosion (which softens the callus), let a metal foil be used!
